lines.text: Many learners say: Almost I fell.
I almost! I almost missed the bus.

native.tip: Kita bilang “hampir saja saya jatuh” dengan hampir di depan. Di bahasa Inggris, urutannya I almost + kata kerja.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Almost I fell.” 😅 Urutannya: I almost + kata kerja: “I almost fell.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “I almost”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I almost fell.” lalu tulis satu kalimat dengan I almost. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “hampir saja saya jatuh” with hampir first. In English, the order is I almost + verb.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Almost I fell.” 😅 The order is I almost + verb: “I almost fell.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
